system.description:
Built on Project FU's Witch.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points — activated.

(House note: FU auto-applies this class benefit — the mechanical field is activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise; the benefit itself is standard Project FU.)

APOTHECARY SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000010]{Afflict} 【Max SL 5】

Choose (SL) damage types when you take the Skill — fixed for the character's life. Action: spend up to (SL × 10) MP; every 10 MP applies Affliction of one chosen type to a creature you can see.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000011]{Regenerate} 【Max SL 3】

Action: spend 5 MP per target to grant Regeneration to up to (SL) creatures you can see.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000012]{Vaccine} 【Max SL 3】

Free action on your turn, 1 IP: remove (SL) status conditions from one creature you can see, and lock each removed condition out for the rest of the conflict scene.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000013]{Infectious} 【Max SL 1】

Action: a second creature you can see suffers one status condition the target is already suffering. A copied Affliction carries every damage type of the original.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000014]{Symptomatic} 【Max SL 1】

Action: one Afflicted target immediately takes 10 damage per type in its Affliction, or any number of Regenerating creatures immediately recover 10 HP. Neither consumes the condition.
